description: This Java source file defines a command handler class for blocking a savings account within the Apache Fineract project. It implements the logic to handle 'block' commands for savings accounts, invoking the appropriate service to perform the action.

classes.name: BlockSavingsAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands to block savings accounts. It uses dependency injection to access the savings account service and processes commands transactionally.

methods.name: BlockSavingsAccountCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the savings account write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the block account command by invoking the write platform service.
